summary: Frontend-only test of the blue edital card change on 6 public pages. PASS: the sentence 'Vestibular Unesp 2027 - VNSP2514 / Fundação VUNESP — Vestibular da Universidade...' is gone from the visible body on all 6 pages. PASS: alignment. On desktop 1920 the card left edge and width equal the content below it exactly (0px difference): inscricao/dados 506/908 (h2, LGPD box, fieldsets), confirmacao 444/1032, realizada/pix 477/966, minhas 460/1000. Mobile 390 has no horizontal overflow, and the LGPD box is 13px, left-aligned and readable. PASS: regression flow (inscricao -> dados (Treineiro) -> confirmacao -> inscricao-realizada R$ 225,00 -> pagamento-pix R$ 225,00 with QR and PIX code -> minhas-inscricoes lists the inscription). FAIL (HIGH): on confirmacao.html, inscricao-realizada.html and pagamento-pix.html the blue card is an EMPTY blue bar, because the 'VESTIBULAR | VESTIBULAR UNESP 2027' h3 is removed at runtime.

ui_bugs.issue: The h3 'VESTIBULAR | VESTIBULAR UNESP 2027' is in the served HTML but gets deleted after load. The card shows as an empty blue strip.

issues: The title 'CONFIRMAÇÃO DOS DADOS' sits ABOVE the blue card, while on the other pages the card comes first.
Mobile 390: the card is at left=12 width=366 but h2.tituloPagina is at left=6 width=378 (6px offset).
About 90px of empty space between the header and the blue card (minor).

action_items: In /app/memory/home_build/build_pages.py, add a REPL entry or a per-page replace that changes "document.querySelectorAll('.blocoPadrao h3').forEach(function(el){ el.remove(); });" to "document.querySelectorAll('.blocoPadrao h3').forEach(function(el){ if(!el.closest('.aocp-edital-card')) el.remove(); });". Affects confirmacao, inscricao-realizada and pagamento-pix (inline script id=__fgv_nuke_empty). Then rebuild and verify the h3 is visible.
Optional: on confirmacao, put the card before the h2 and fix the 6px mobile offset between the h2 and the card.
critical_code_review_comments: Moving the card into .blocoPadrao .dados conflicts with the legacy __fgv_nuke_empty script, which removes every '.blocoPadrao h3'.

The remaining 'VNSP2514' strings are not part of the card and look intended: JS edital fields, the dados-inscricao concurso <option> 'Vestibular Unesp 2027 - VNSP2514', and the pagamento-pix line 'Universidade Estadual Paulista (Unesp) - VNSP2514'.

success_rate.frontend: 75% (text removal, alignment and flow pass; header missing on 3 of 6 pages)

seed_data_creation: Created a test inscription for CPF 111.444.777-35 (teste@example.com, Treineiro). Deleted it afterwards via DELETE /api/admin/inscriptions/{id} and /api/admin/cadastros/11144477735.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The full inscricao flow works in one script: fill NOME, CPF, data, SEXO; click the 4 radio testids; CEP 01310-100 autofills the address; fill numero, email, celular; select #DOC_TIPO index 1; set_input_files on input-doc-frente and input-doc-verso; check declaracao_veracidade; click btn-continuar-inscricao. On dados: select-vaga index 178 (Treineiro), select-municipio-prova index 1, check all checkboxes, click btn-cadastrar. On confirmacao click btn-confirmar-inscricao, then conf-success-ok. On realizada click btn-pagar-inscricao. To verify the fix, check that '.aocp-edital-card h3' exists after load on confirmacao and pagamento-pix.
rca of the issue: build_pages.py lines 65-69 move .aocp-edital-card into '.blocoPadrao .dados'. The inline script __fgv_nuke_empty in confirmacao/inscricao-realizada/pagamento-pix (from the backup pages) runs document.querySelectorAll('.blocoPadrao h3').forEach(el=>el.remove()). I confirmed this by hooking Element.remove: the h3 is removed by confirmacao.html line ~1542. inscricao and dados-inscricao do not have this script, so they show the header.
